mechanism_narrative: The weekly decline in RETAIL_REC is decelerating: week-on-week changes of -7.2, then -16.3, then -6.4 points show the shock is exhausting its momentum, so the next 28-day mean sits above the last 28-day mean.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC weekly changes are -7.2, -16.3, -6.4 points from t-3w to t-0w
failure_condition: The mean RETAIL_REC over the 28 days after 15 January 2022 is lower than over the preceding 28 days despite the week-on-week decline shrinking in the final interval.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT collapsing 31.0 points in three weeks marks a capitulation threshold: when transit use falls this far this fast, containment peaks within a week and trip demand reverts, lifting RETAIL_REC over the following two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls more than 25 points below its t-3w level within three weeks
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT moved -0.9 to -31.9 percent over the four snapshot weeks
regime_hint: peak curtailment of public transport use
failure_condition: TRANSIT drops more than 25 points in three weeks and yet the mean RETAIL_REC over the following 14 days is below its mean over the preceding 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM crossing below zero (-0.6 to -5.3) while RESIDENTIAL holds above +12 signals households abandoning even essential trips for home confinement, which suppresses discretionary retail further over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM crosses below 0 percent while RESIDENTIAL exceeds +12 percent
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM fell from +21.6 to -5.3 while RESIDENTIAL rose from +6.3 to +14.7
failure_condition: Whenever GROCERY_PHARM is negative and RESIDENTIAL exceeds +12 percent, the mean RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is higher than over the prior 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: State containment stringency moves WORKPLACES first; a 21.5-point three-week drop in WORKPLACES confirms active restrictions that already depress RETAIL_REC, so relaxation as the wave recedes lifts retail over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES falls more than 20 points relative to its t-3w level within three weeks
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES fell from -10.9 to -32.4 percent over three weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC's next-28-day mean is below its last-28-day mean in the majority of episodes where WORKPLACES falls more than 20 points in three weeks.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS and RESIDENTIAL act as substitutes: three weeks of PARKS decline (-20.0 to -41.6) alongside rising RESIDENTIAL (+6.3 to +14.7) quantifies voluntary outdoor avoidance, and the fastest-decaying component of that avoidance restores retail footfall within one week.
candidate_trigger: PARKS declines more than 15 points over three weeks while RESIDENTIAL rises more than 6 points over the same window
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS fell 21.6 points across the snapshot while RESIDENTIAL rose 8.4 points
regime_hint: voluntary outdoor avoidance during an active infection wave
failure_condition: PARKS rebounds by more than 5 points week-on-week while RETAIL_REC stays flat or declines over the following week.

mechanism_narrative: 15 January sits at the Delhi winter respiratory-season peak; the seasonal trough in discretionary outings bottoms in mid-January and climbs through February, so the coming 28-day RETAIL_REC mean exceeds the last 28-day mean independently of any policy change.
evidence_refs: fact:decision point 2022-01-15 is mid-January, the seasonal winter trough in Delhi
regime_hint: winter seasonal trough transitioning to February recovery
failure_condition: The mean RETAIL_REC over the 28 days after 15 January is lower than over the 28 days before it, contradicting the seasonal January-bottom pattern.

mechanism_narrative: Four successive weekly declines in RETAIL_REC (-11.1, -18.3, -34.6, -41.0) with no reversal signal indicate unbroken downward momentum, so the next week extends the fall and drags the 4-week mean below the prior one.
candidate_trigger: RETAIL_REC records a fourth consecutive weekly decline exceeding 5 points
evidence_refs: fact:all six series except RESIDENTIAL declined in every snapshot week
regime_hint: uninterrupted mobility contraction with no plateau
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC turns positive within one week of four consecutive weekly declines of more than 5 points each.

mechanism_narrative: The wide gap between RETAIL_REC (-41.0) and near-zero GROCERY_PHARM (-5.3) identifies an essentials-only restriction regime; normalisation of the grocery series upward precedes exit from that regime and lifts the next 28-day retail mean.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM turns up by more than 3 points week-on-week from a negative level
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC at -41.0 versus GROCERY_PHARM at -5.3 indicates non-essential activity is the restricted margin
regime_hint: essentials-only restriction regime during the January 2022 wave
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM rises more than 3 points week-on-week from a negative level yet the next 28-day RETAIL_REC mean remains below the prior 28-day mean.
